title: helm(private): stabilize init hooks, KMS nodeSelector & upgrade/rollback compatibility
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: stabilize the Helm chart init hooks used by Redwood Private installer, add KMS nodeSelector support, and make values schema changes to improve upgrade/rollback compatibility. This PR addresses three related pain points discovered during recent Private deployments and upgrade tests: (1) init-job hooks intermittently failing when PVCs or CRDs race vs. post-install jobs, (2) customers requiring KMS/HA components pinned to specific node pools via nodeSelector, and (3) schema changes that caused helm upgrade --install to fail during rollbacks on older clusters. Changes in this PR: checklist: - [x] Convert init jobs to hook-weighted sequential hooks with explicit pre-install and post-upgrade ordering and stronger failure handling (backoffLimit/ttlSecondsAfterFinished). - [x] Add optional values.private.kms.nodeSelector and values.private.kms.affinity blocks; templating guards to only render KMS pod node selection when set. - [x] Rework values schema (values.schema.json) to allow missing deprecated fields and provide compatibility shims for upgrade/rollback. - [x] Add chart tests for helm template with both old and new values shapes (migration test). - [x] Add notes for operators in README / upgrade notes about running pre-upgrade sanity hooks. Migration notes: The schema change adds optional keys and tolerant validation for deprecated fields. Operators upgrading from v1.7.x must run `helm upgrade --install --atomic --wait` or pre-run the provided `preflight` hook to ensure CRDs and PVCs are present. The README includes a small script to run the preflight checks. This description is intentionally compact; see commits and changed_files for details and CI / review thread below.
commits_summary: 4 commits: - refactor(init-hooks): add hook weights + sequential ordering + ttl/cleanup - feat(kms): add nodeSelector/affinity templating for private KMS deployment - chore(schema): relax values.schema.json for upgrade/rollback compatibility + migration notes - test(chart): add helm template migration tests and e2e preflight sanity check
changed_files: charts/redwood-private/templates/init-jobs.yaml (reworked hook weights, added ttl and backoffLimit)
charts/redwood-private/values.yaml (documented new keys and deprecated aliases)
review_comments: Diego Martinez (comment): The sequential hook weights look good, but we should be explicit about ttlSecondsAfterFinished on long-running post-install jobs to avoid stuck release states. Please add a short comment in the template explaining why TTL is necessary.
Asha Patel (reply): Added comment and set ttlSecondsAfterFinished=3600 for post-install cleanup. Left a TODO to revisit if customers need longer retention.
Lin Zhao (comment): We need to ensure that nodeSelector templating doesn't render an empty `nodeSelector: {}` block; please add a guard helper to render only when keys provided.
Asha Patel (reply): Implemented _renderNodeSelector helper in _helpers.tpl and added tests to cover empty/missing values cases.
Marta Kline (request changes): Can we add a short migration test that simulates a helm upgrade with the old values shape? This would have caught the previous rollback failure seen in SUP-314.
Asha Patel (reply): Added migration-test.yaml and expanded CI matrix to run helm template with both old and new shapes. CI updated to include these checks.
Diego Martinez (approve): LGTM after the small docs tweak. Approving for squash+merge.
release_notes: Helm: Stabilize init hooks for Redwood Private to avoid race conditions during install/upgrade (hooks now use weights and explicit TTL/backoff).
Helm: Add optional values.private.kms.nodeSelector and values.private.kms.affinity to pin KMS pods to specific node pools.
Helm: Relax values.schema.json to improve upgrade/rollback compatibility; migration notes added to README.
Helm: Add preflight job and chart tests to validate migration from older values shapes.
notes_for_upgrade: Operators upgrading from <= v1.7.x: run the included preflight script or `helm upgrade --install --atomic --wait` to ensure CRDs and PVCs are present before rolling the chart. If you use KMS nodeSelector, add values.private.kms.nodeSelector in your values file (example in README). The schema change is backward compatible but running the preflight checks is recommended for clusters with older CRD/state.
